name: Ayara
description: A queen who still partakes in the Wild Hunt but argues for peace; Oko impersonates her.

description_citations.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
description_citations.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garruk joins the twins in chasing the Wild Hunt to save their father, and Oko, disguised as Ayara, shoots the stag.
timeline.quote: Oko took the form of the elven queen Ayara and shot the stag in the chest with an arrow.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Wild Hunt a figure looking like Queen Ayara mortally wounds the stag with an arrow.
timeline.quote: A brawl ensues, which ends with a person looking like Queen Ayara shooting the stag with an arrow and mortally wounding it.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Within days of the Phyrexian invasion the courts fall, the Kenriths die and Ayara is compleated.
timeline.quote: Within days of the Invasion, the courts of the Realm had fallen, the Kenriths were dead, and Ayara had been compleated , along with her guards.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rankle follows Chulane and sees floating Locthwain Castle and Queen Ayara's procession.
timeline.quote: this was his first glimpse of the floating castle

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Chulane begs Queen Ayara for a word, and she invites him into her carriage to tell her everything.
timeline.quote: "Well, come inside and tell me everything."

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle glimpses Ayara's face, is smitten, and decides he must become her next husband.
timeline.quote: He must become Ayara's next husband.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle and Torbran see Locthwain crashed to the ground, its knights and the queen transformed by Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: To Rankle's shock, she was not herself.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Oko tries to turn Queen Ayara against humans but she finds him suspect.

citation.text: "Oko", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko, as Queen Ayara, shoots the stag; he evades Garruk but is pinned by the twins' ice.
timeline.quote: he took the form of Queen Ayara (who had hidden near the back of the gathering to not be seen) and shot the stag in the chest with an arrow.

citation.text: "Oko", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayara stays as ruler of Locthwain rather than withdrawing with her kin into the Wilds.
timeline.quote: Ayara remained as the ruler of Locthwain rather than withdraw with her brethren into the Wilds

citation.text: "Ayara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayara and the court of Locthwain are compleated in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Ayara, along with the rest of the court of Locthwain, was compleated as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Ayara", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayara and most of the court of Locthwain are compleated and the castle becomes a Phyrexian fortress.
timeline.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Ayara and most of the court of Locthwain were compleated .

citation.text: "Locthwain", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rankle meets Ayara and resolves to be her next husband, seeking a love potion.
timeline.quote: He resolved to be her next husband and set off to find a love potion.

citation.text: "Rankle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Locthwain, Rankle finds Ayara compleated and steals Torbran's ring of three wishes.
timeline.quote: Unfazed, he stole Torbran's ring of three wishes

citation.text: "Rankle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko, disguised as Queen Ayara, kills the enchanted stag during the Wild Hunt to incite war.
timeline.quote: The enchanted stag was killed by Oko, transformed to appear as Queen Ayara

citation.text: "Restoration of the High King", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eldraine's courts fall within days of Realmbreaker's appearance; the High King and Queen are killed and Ayara is compleated.
timeline.quote: High King Algenus and Queen Linden Kenrith were killed

citation.text: "Wicked Slumber", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Queen Ayara reigned over the Locthwain Court

relations.quote: But Rankle took no notice of this, for he was smitten .
